summary: Added an opt-in MiniMax-M3 SwiGLU-OAI activation to the existing gfx950 packed-A4/static-W4 fused MoE kernel, retaining SiLU defaults. Qualified exact 6144x3072, 128-expert, top-k-4 routed projections and the one-expert shared projection pattern against independent MXFP4 dequantize/FP32 references. The validated path accepts dynamically quantized packed FP4 activations; the existing on-device BF16-to-FP4 inline variant remains outside the qualified path.

tests.what_was_measured: GPU numerical correctness for routed plus shared experts at hidden=6144, intermediate/shared_intermediate=3072, routed_experts=128, top_k=4 for token batches 1,2,4,16,32,256. Cosine 0.99999648..0.99999815; max absolute error 0.00149..0.00261; all outputs finite.

Six GPU cases covering decode/prefill sizes, nonuniform and duplicate routes, routed plus one-expert shared outputs, zero blocks and 1e-6/1e3 adversarial activation blocks, all finite, against independent dequantized FP32 references with normalized-logit threshold 0.002.

Defect characterization before quarantine: BM32 packed A4W4 passed; inline BF16-to-FP4 had normalized error 0.0083758 and BM64 interleaved had 0.9938281. These variants remain explicitly xfailed and are not claimed.
Final focused regression: 7 GPU numerical cases passed.
Same-shape/state latency with strict numerics: legacy SiLU stage1/stage2 6.5/5.2 us; SwiGLU-OAI 7.3/5.7 us.

remaining_limitations: Kernel-level synthetic projection qualification only: no full MiniMax-M3 generation and no model weights were downloaded.
No multi-rank expert-parallel qualification. The packed-A4 fused path does not expose valid-mask/non-local-slot reduction; callers must compact/remap local experts before launch.

The on-device BF16-to-FP4 inline variant and BM64 interleaved layout remain numerically unqualified and are explicit xfails; this candidate uses externally dynamically quantized packed FP4 activations with per-32 E8M0 scales.

The independent reference and test quantizer implement MXFP4 per-group-32 E8M0 conventions; the public model metadata specifies Quark half-even/even scale calculation. No arbitrary INT4 or BF16-activation/W4 result is presented as A4W4.
A8W4 remains independently xfailed and is not part of this outcome.
